subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or should maintainers accept the credential-gated proof gap for this narrow header-only fix?
rationale: The contributor cannot supply a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and OpenClaw policy treats external API behavior as needing live proof unless maintainers intentionally accept the gap.

options.title: Require or provide live smoke
options.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live output showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint after the header change before merge.

options.title: Accept credential gap
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the missing live smoke because the patch is narrow, covered by unit tests, and matches the issue reporter's live service evidence.

options.title: Pick another candidate PR
options.body: Maintain one sibling same-root PR as the landing path and close the rest only after that fix is merged or proof-positive.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live smoke
recommendation.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live output showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint after the header change before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint detection feature history and the provider docs contract.
